subject: general
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required if the sentence is correct as given.

Welcome to the Ministry of Magic, (please administer your name) and business.
solution:
The correct answer is "**please state your name.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct option to replace the word "administer" is option 3.
 
• **In option 3, "state," makes more sense in the context of providing one's name**.
 
 
• "State" in verb form means to say or write something, especially formally. (कुछ कहना या लिखना)
 
 
 
• "Direct" (Option 2) implies that the person should physically point their name in a certain direction which is incorrect.
 
• "Inform your entitle" (Option 4) is grammatically incorrect and doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• Thus, the given phrase can be replaced by the phrase "please state your name."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
